patch.value: Enforce the configured statement coverage threshold in the package gate

package.json declares coverageGate.thresholds.statements=100, but scripts/coverage-gate.ts forwards only line, branch and function thresholds to the native Node test runner. The runner exposes no statement metric, so a green coverage command cannot substantiate the mandated 100/100/100/100 claim. The new numerical adapter was independently measured with c8, but whole-package statement coverage remains unmeasured. This is a package gate issue, not an upstream CLI or SDK defect.

Every configured coverage dimension is actually measured and enforced across every authored runtime source; a failing statement threshold rejects the gate; omitted sources and existing line branch function regressions still reject; complete real package tests report exact four-dimensional totals without exclusions or lowered thresholds

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
BEFORE: npm run coverage — PASS, but the gate forwarded only line/branch/function thresholds to the Node test runner. The configured statements=100 threshold in package.json was never read, measured, or enforced. The gate reported "thresholds met" without substantiating the 100/100/100/100 claim. The Node test runner exposes no --test-coverage-statements flag, so even forwarding the threshold would be a no-op.

AFTER: npm run coverage — PASS, 100/100/100/100. The gate now:
1. Reads the statements threshold from coverageGate.thresholds in package.json.
2. Sets NODE_V8_COVERAGE when spawning the test runner to collect raw V8 block coverage.
3. Computes statement coverage from V8 block ranges (flattened per-process, merged across processes by max count, with a subsumption filter for V8 range-boundary phantoms).
4. Enforces the threshold: fails if statement coverage is below the configured value.
5. Reports four-dimensional totals: lines, branches, functions, statements.

Property: every V8 block range was entered at least once (count > 0). Domain: all block ranges with isBlockCoverage true across every required source file. For a 100% threshold, block coverage is equivalent to statement coverage (all blocks entered iff all statements executed).

Regression test verified: reverting the enforcement block in runGate causes the test file to fail (imports computeStatementCoverage and parseLcovTotals which only exist in the fix). Reverting the entire scripts/coverage-gate.ts causes the test file to fail to load.

patch.value: Enforce the configured statement coverage threshold by measuring V8 block coverage via NODE_V8_COVERAGE and rejecting the gate when the percentage falls below the configured threshold.
